d-i/forky/hooks/target/etc/systemd/syste.current:
# Isolate helper PIDs without hiding host-wide memory/PSI metrics.
# Setup owns raw devices; maintenance needs only zram controls and PSI triggers.
d-i/forky/hooks/target/etc/systemd/syste.historical:
# PID-only isolation: helpers do not consume host PIDs. Keep host UID and
# capabilities for Bluetooth/device/sysfs operations; never add PrivateUsers.
